reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin for monitoring multiple provider balances and subscription quotas, analyzing local token usage, and presenting the results through a usage dashboard with periodic refresh and configurable provider adapters.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供多供应商余额、订阅额度和 Token 用量监测与可视化分析。
summaries.en: Provides multi-provider balance and quota monitoring plus token-usage analytics for the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads configured provider credentials on the server side
Queries configured external provider balance and quota endpoints
Displays balance, quota, usage, and threshold status in a web panel
Supports restricted declarative GET requests with JSON extraction
